items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: Now Paul saw me and he okayed the idea that we'd try a solo with him and that's the first time I did it with a band.

ctx.x: So anyway we went to the thing and the guy heard us and so he said, well there's an opening with Paul Ash, for the opening show at the Oriental. So, I -- he booked me on it. Now Paul saw me and he okayed the idea that we'd try a solo with him and that's the first time I did it with a band.
